records.text: Owens said the France trip was the only event she ever canceled with Turning Point USA, that Charlie Kirk approved it, and that she arranged for Michael Knowles to substitute.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I just want to address that because again, it's just, he's such a slime ball. That is the only time that I canceled an event with Turning Point USA. ... I had Turning Point USA event and I was like, I will literally give anything to be able to go and spend like he was like, of course you have to go. ... Of course you have to go, please just get me a substitute for who like who can speak for you. ... I then called Michael Knowles and asked him if he would sub for me. And I was unbelievably apologetic to the team. I had never, ever, ever in our entire working relationship had I ever canceled an event.

verification.notes: Owens' October 2022 trip to Paris with Kanye West is independently documented, and the source transcript records her account that this was her only TPUSA cancellation, Kirk approved it, and Michael Knowles substituted. Searches found no independent public confirmation of the exclusivity, approval, or substitution details. The documented trip is true, while the private coordination claims remain supported only by Owens' account.
